name: Form
title: Form 表单

description.en: Manage a model, field registration, validation and submit snapshots.
description.zh: 管理模型、字段注册、校验与提交快照。

when.en: Use when several inputs must share validation and one submit result.
when.zh: 多个输入需要统一校验并产生一个提交结果时使用。

faq.zh: 同一路径只能有一个字段所有者。异步校验返回 superseded 表示快照已变化；不要把它当作 valid。业务提交请求由应用管理，普通 Page 需要同步 submitting。
faq.en: Only one field may own a path. A superseded asynchronous validation belongs to an outdated snapshot and is not a valid result. Application requests remain external; ordinary Pages must synchronize submitting.

Set an external error; message=null clears it.
隐藏反馈，不修改字段是否有效。

rules.zh: 字段路径到校验规则的映射，与 FormItem 和字段规则合并。
rules.en: Map field paths to validation rules, merged with FormItem and field rules.

description.en: Connect a named field to Form and render its label, help and validation feedback.
description.zh: 连接命名字段与 Form，承载标签、帮助和校验反馈。

when.en: Use around one logical field; an object-valued custom control still owns one path.
when.zh: 包裹一个逻辑字段；复合控件可用一个对象值占用一个路径。

content.zh:
用 name 将内部控件连接至模型。labelPlacement="left" 将标签放在侧边；label、description、suffix、help、error 等插槽可组合自己的结构。

### 自定义标签与后缀

替换基础示例中的 FormItem；不要再同时设置非空 label 文字。

```xml
<rmp-form-item name="value" label="" label-placement="left">
  <text slot="label">Display name</text>
  <rmp-field placeholder="Name" />
  <text slot="suffix">Optional</text>
</rmp-form-item>
```
content.en:
Use name to connect the inner field to the model. labelPlacement="left" places the label beside the field. Compose label, description, suffix, help and error slots as needed.

### Custom label and suffix

Replace the basic FormItem and keep its text label empty.

```xml
<rmp-form-item name="value" label="" label-placement="left">
  <text slot="label">Display name</text>
  <rmp-field placeholder="Name" />
  <text slot="suffix">Optional</text>
</rmp-form-item>
```

faq.zh: 自定义 label、description 或 help 插槽时清空对应文字属性，避免两份内容。一个复合字段应只注册一个对象值，不要让多个字段重复占用同一路径。
faq.en: Clear the matching text property when supplying label, description or help slots. A composite field should register one object value rather than let several fields own the same path.

expected.zh: 运行后可直接操作此 FormItem 示例；修改字段后点击 Submit，页面显示提交的模型；Reset 恢复初始值。
expected.en: Interact with this FormItem example. Edit the field and choose Submit to display the submitted model; Reset restores initial values.

description.en: Submit or reset the nearest Form using its current pending and disabled state.
description.zh: 根据最近 Form 的待处理与禁用状态提交或重置。

when.en: Use inside Form instead of manually coordinating submit locks.
when.zh: 在 Form 内触发提交或重置，并跟随表单锁定状态。

content.zh:
action="reset" 恢复重置基线。requireValid="{{true}}" 只允许已知 valid 的状态，需配合 Form 的 validateOnMount 或显式静默校验。

### 已知有效才允许提交

下面片段放在已有 Form 内；同时在 Form 上设置 validate-on-mount="{{true}}"。

```xml
<rmp-form-button require-valid="{{true}}">Submit when valid</rmp-form-button>
<rmp-form-button action="reset">Restore initial values</rmp-form-button>
```
content.en:
action="reset" restores the reset baseline. requireValid="{{true}}" requires an already valid state; combine it with Form validateOnMount or explicit silent validation.

### Require known validity

Place this inside the existing Form and set validate-on-mount="{{true}}" on Form.

```xml
<rmp-form-button require-valid="{{true}}">Submit when valid</rmp-form-button>
<rmp-form-button action="reset">Restore initial values</rmp-form-button>
```

faq.zh: 默认提交按钮允许尚未校验的表单触发校验以显示错误。按钮只在 Form 内工作；组件不会等待 submit 事件监听器的 Promise。
faq.en: By default, an unvalidated form may be submitted to reveal errors. The button needs a Form ancestor. It does not await a Promise returned by a submit event listener.

expected.zh: 运行后可直接操作此 FormButton 示例；修改字段后点击 Submit，页面显示提交的模型；Reset 恢复初始值。
expected.en: Interact with this FormButton example. Edit the field and choose Submit to display the submitted model; Reset restores initial values.

disabled.zh: 禁用此按钮，不改变表单其他字段的校验状态。
disabled.en: Disable this button without changing other fields or their validation state.

name: Input
title: Input 输入框

description.en: Edit a single-line string with native keyboard and focus events.
description.zh: 使用原生键盘和焦点事件编辑单行文本。

when.en: Use for names, identifiers and short text.
when.zh: 用于名称、标识和短文本。

content.zh:
设置 type="number" 切换键盘；password 用于密码输入。maxlength="-1" 不额外限制长度。outline 与 underline 可作为轻量外观，布局由 FormItem 管理。

### 密码与只读

替换示例中的字段即可；type 只改变键盘，不执行数值转换。

```xml
<rmp-field password="{{true}}" maxlength="64" confirm-type="done" appearance="underline" />
<!-- For readonly display, set readonly="{{true}}" instead. -->
```
content.en:
Use type="number" for a numeric keyboard and password for password input. maxlength="-1" adds no limit. outline and underline provide light wrappers while FormItem owns layout.

### Password and readonly

Replace the field in the basic example. The input type changes the keyboard without coercing the model.

```xml
<rmp-field password="{{true}}" maxlength="64" confirm-type="done" appearance="underline" />
<!-- For readonly display, set readonly="{{true}}" instead. -->
```

faq.zh: 键盘类型不会把模型自动转换成 number。文本默认 blur 校验；已有可见错误时，后续输入会重新检查未指定 trigger 的规则。
faq.en: A numeric keyboard does not convert the model to a number. Text fields validate on blur by default; subsequent input rechecks rules without explicit triggers when an error is already visible.

name: Textarea
title: Textarea 多行输入

description.en: Edit longer text with automatic height and an optional character counter.
description.zh: 支持自动高度和可选字数统计的长文本输入。

when.en: Use for descriptions or notes that need multiple lines.
when.zh: 用于描述、备注等多行文字。

content.zh:
autoHeight="{{true}}" 随内容增高，showCount="{{true}}" 显示计数。maxlength 可设置业务上限，appearance="outline" 提供基础边框。

### 固定业务上限

替换基础字段并保留 FormItem。

```xml
<rmp-field placeholder="Up to 500 characters" maxlength="500" auto-height="{{true}}" show-count="{{true}}" appearance="outline" />
```
content.en:
autoHeight="{{true}}" grows with content; showCount="{{true}}" displays a counter. Set maxlength for a business limit and appearance="outline" for a base border.

### Bounded long text

Replace the basic field while retaining FormItem.

```xml
<rmp-field placeholder="Up to 500 characters" maxlength="500" auto-height="{{true}}" show-count="{{true}}" appearance="outline" />
```

faq.zh: 不要用 fixed 高度与自动增高同时争夺布局。焦点与键盘上推由原生 textarea 决定，真机键盘行为不能由浏览器预览代替。
faq.en: Do not let a fixed height compete with automatic height. Native textarea controls focus and keyboard adjustment; browser previews do not verify device keyboard behavior.

name: Checkbox
title: Checkbox 复选框

description.en: Represent a Boolean choice, including a valid false value.
description.zh: 表示布尔选择，false 也是有效值。

when.en: Use for an agreement or an independent yes/no choice.
when.zh: 用于协议确认或独立的是非选择。

content.zh:
用 accepted 规则要求必须勾选，而不是仅配置 required。默认 false 是有效的布尔值。独立使用时监听 change 并同步 value。

### 必须同意

在页面事件或 onReady 中设置 accepted 规则，并将 rules="{{rules}}" 绑定到 Form。

```js
this.setData({ rules: { value: [{ accepted: true, message: 'Agreement is required' }] } });
```
content.en:
Use an accepted rule when checking is mandatory. A false Boolean remains a valid nonempty value. For standalone use, synchronize value from change.

### Require agreement

Set an accepted rule in a Page handler or onReady, and bind rules="{{rules}}" on Form.

```js
this.setData({ rules: { value: [{ accepted: true, message: 'Agreement is required' }] } });
```

faq.zh: required 不把 false 当空值，因此无法表达“必须同意”。禁用字段不参与校验；readonly 仍参与校验。
faq.en: required does not treat false as empty, so it cannot enforce agreement. Disabled fields are excluded from validation, while readonly fields remain included.

name: Switch
title: Switch 开关

description.en: Toggle a Boolean setting through a native switch.
description.zh: 通过原生开关切换布尔设置。

when.en: Use for a setting whose effect is understood immediately.
when.zh: 用于含义明确、需要即时切换的设置。

content.zh:
在 Form 中由 name 对应的模型值控制开关；也可独立绑定 value。禁用或只读时不会提交交互修改。

### 展示只读设置

替换字段后，模型仍参与校验，但用户不能切换。

```xml
<rmp-field readonly="{{true}}" />
```
content.en:
Inside Form, the model value at name controls the switch. Standalone switches may bind value directly. Disabled or readonly switches reject interaction changes.

### Readonly setting

Replace the field; it remains in validation while interaction is blocked.

```xml
<rmp-field readonly="{{true}}" />
```

faq.zh: Switch 表达 Boolean，不能用数字或字符串作为多个状态。一次 change 的 value 是布尔值，不是原生事件对象。
faq.en: Switch represents a Boolean rather than several numeric or string states. change.detail.value is the Boolean value, not a native event object.

name: RadioGroup
title: RadioGroup 单选组

description.en: Choose one scalar value from visible options.
description.zh: 从可见选项中选择一个标量值。

when.en: Use when alternatives should remain visible.
when.zh: 需要始终展示互斥选项时使用。

content.zh:
options 使用 {label,value,disabled?}；0 可作为选项值。variant="buttons" 显示按钮布局；collapseAfter 可折叠长列表。

### 按钮与折叠列表

沿用基础示例 options，分别选择一种展示方式。

```xml
<rmp-field options="{{options}}" variant="buttons" />
<!-- Or: variant="list" collapse-after="2" -->
```
content.en:
Use {label,value,disabled?} options; 0 is a valid option value. variant="buttons" selects the button layout, and collapseAfter collapses long lists.

### Buttons or a collapsed list

Reuse options from the basic example and choose one presentation.

```xml
<rmp-field options="{{options}}" variant="buttons" />
<!-- Or: variant="list" collapse-after="2" -->
```

faq.zh: 模型中保存选项值，不保存选项序号。labelKey/valueKey 映射业务字段；禁用选项不能被点击选择。
faq.en: The model stores the option value rather than its index. labelKey/valueKey map business data, and disabled options cannot be selected.

methods: 注册供字符串规则引用的函数，不通过 WXML 传函数。
Register functions referenced by named rules without passing functions through WXML.

expected.zh: 运行后可直接操作此 RadioGroup 示例；修改字段后点击 Submit，页面显示提交的模型；Reset 恢复初始值。

name: CheckboxGroup
title: CheckboxGroup 复选组

description.en: Choose an ordered array of option values.
description.zh: 选择由选项值组成的数组。

when.en: Use when several options may be selected together.
when.zh: 允许同时选择多个选项时使用。

content.zh:
模型值为选项值数组。variant="buttons" 改变展示，collapseAfter="2" 折叠后续选项，展开不会丢弃已选值。

### 自定义选项键

先在 Page 中将 options 设置为具有 text、id 的对象数组，再替换字段。

```xml
<rmp-field options="{{options}}" label-key="text" value-key="id" variant="buttons" />
```
content.en:
The model holds an array of option values. variant="buttons" changes presentation; collapseAfter="2" collapses later options without discarding selections.

### Map application option keys

Set options to an array with text/id fields in Page, then replace the field.

```xml
<rmp-field options="{{options}}" label-key="text" value-key="id" variant="buttons" />
```

faq.zh: 不要使用逗号分隔字符串代替数组。重复值不能表达多个独立选项，业务 options 的 value 应唯一。
faq.en: Use an array rather than a comma-separated string. Duplicate values cannot represent independent options; option values should be unique.

methods: 注册供字符串规则引用的函数，不通过 WXML 传函数。
Register functions referenced by named rules without passing functions through WXML.

name: Select
title: Select 选择器

description.en: Choose mapped option values with a native picker or a confirmation popup.
description.zh: 通过原生 picker 或确认弹窗选择映射后的选项值。

when.en: Use for longer option lists; use popup for multiple selections.
when.zh: 用于较长选项列表；多选使用 popup 模式。

content.zh:
presentation="native" 使用原生单选。presentation="popup" 配合 multiple="{{true}}" 使用多选确认弹窗，勾选只改草稿，确认后才更新模型。

### 弹窗多选与取消

先在 Page 中把 model.value 初始化为 []，再替换字段；取消不会提交草稿。

```xml
<rmp-field options="{{options}}" presentation="popup" multiple="{{true}}" title="Choose cities" />
```
content.en:
presentation="native" uses a native single-choice picker. Combine presentation="popup" with multiple="{{true}}" for a confirmation popup: toggles edit a draft, and confirm commits it.

### Popup multiple selection

Initialize model.value to [] in Page, then replace the field. Cancel discards the draft.

```xml
<rmp-field options="{{options}}" presentation="popup" multiple="{{true}}" title="Choose cities" />
```

faq.zh: 取消弹窗丢弃草稿。多选需要数组模型；单选输出选项值，原生滚轮索引不会进入模型。
faq.en: Cancelling discards the draft. Multiple selection requires an array model. Single selection returns an option value; native wheel indices do not enter the model.

name: ColumnPicker
title: ColumnPicker 多列选择器

description.en: Return one selected value from each independent column.
description.zh: 返回各个独立列选中的值。

when.en: Use for several parallel wheels, not dependent tree levels.
when.zh: 用于多个并列滚轮；树形依赖使用 Cascader。

faq.zh: 此组件不是树形级联选择。返回值不是滚轮索引数组，而是各列实际的 value。
faq.en: This is not a tree cascader. Its result contains actual option values rather than wheel indices.

name: DatePicker
title: DatePicker 日期时间选择器

description.en: Select a date or time through the native picker.
description.zh: 通过原生 picker 选择日期或时间。

when.en: Use for compact date/time input with explicit bounds.
when.zh: 需要紧凑的日期时间输入与明确范围时使用。

content.zh:
mode="date" 使用 YYYY-MM-DD，mode="time" 使用 HH:mm。min/max 与 mode 的格式保持一致；fields 可设置日期精度。

### 时间选择

将 model.value 改为 HH:mm，例如 09:00，再使用此字段。

```xml
<rmp-field mode="time" min="09:00" max="18:00" default-picker-value="09:00" />
```
content.en:
mode="date" uses YYYY-MM-DD; mode="time" uses HH:mm. Format min/max for the selected mode. fields controls date precision.

### Time selection

Set model.value to an HH:mm string such as 09:00, then use this field.

```xml
<rmp-field mode="time" min="09:00" max="18:00" default-picker-value="09:00" />
```

faq.zh: defaultPickerValue 只在没有模型值时定位滚轮，不等于提交值。需要业务校验时另配规则，不要只依赖选择范围。
faq.en: defaultPickerValue positions an empty picker but does not commit a value. Add validation rules for business requirements rather than relying only on picker bounds.

name: RegionPicker
title: RegionPicker 地区选择器

description.en: Select native administrative regions and retain native change metadata.
description.zh: 选择原生行政地区，并保留原生 change 元数据。

when.en: Use for WeChat-provided regions; use Cascader for business-specific trees.
when.zh: 用于微信提供的行政地区；业务树使用 Cascader。

content.zh:
模型值为地区名称数组，level 控制原生选择级别。change 会保留原生地区编码等详情，可用于提交业务需要的编码。

### 限定原生选择级别

level 由微信原生 picker 决定，业务分类树应使用 Cascader。

```xml
<rmp-field level="city" />
```
content.en:
The model holds an array of region names. level selects the native region level. change retains native metadata, including codes when provided by the platform.

### Choose the native region level

WeChat native picker defines level behavior; use Cascader for application category trees.

```xml
<rmp-field level="city" />
```

faq.zh: 地区数据由微信平台提供；任意业务分类树请使用 Cascader。不要把 names 数组误当地区编码。
faq.en: WeChat provides the region dataset; use Cascader for custom category trees. Do not interpret the names array as administrative codes.

faq.en: Applications own asynchronous loading. Do not use [] for unknown children: that marks a leaf and permits committing it. The path array stores each selected option value.

name: Calendar
title: Calendar 日历

description.en: Choose a YYYY-MM-DD date in an inline month grid.
description.zh: 在内嵌月视图中选择 YYYY-MM-DD 日期。

when.en: Use when surrounding dates should stay visible.
when.zh: 需要同时查看相邻日期时使用。

content.zh:
month 选择显示月份，min/max 和 disabledDates 控制不可选日期；weekdays 可替换七个星期表头，应用可进行本地化。

### 明确选择范围

替换字段；没有显式 min 时，过去日期不会默认禁用。

```xml
<rmp-field month="2026-11" min="2026-11-01" max="2026-11-30" disabled-dates="{{disabledDates}}" />
```
content.en:
month controls the visible month; min/max and disabledDates constrain dates. Replace the seven weekdays labels for localization.

### Constrain date selection

Replace the field. Without an explicit min, past dates are not disabled automatically.

```xml
<rmp-field month="2026-11" min="2026-11-01" max="2026-11-30" disabled-dates="{{disabledDates}}" />
```

faq.zh: 不会默认禁用过去日期。日期使用 YYYY-MM-DD 字符串；范围与时区业务规则由应用定义。
faq.en: Past dates are not disabled automatically. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD strings; applications define range and timezone policies.

methods: 注册供字符串规则引用的函数，不通过 WXML 传函数。

description.en: Select image/video files and coordinate upload tasks through an application adapter.
description.zh: 选择图片或视频，通过应用适配器协调上传任务。

when.en: Use when files belong to a form and unfinished uploads must block submission.
when.zh: 文件属于表单且未完成上传需要阻止提交时使用。

faq.zh: 未完成、失败的上传任务阻止提交；删除文件解除阻塞。服务地址、认证、预览和错误提示由应用管理，不能在 data/WXML 传函数适配器。
faq.en: Unfinished and failed uploads block submission; removal releases the blocker. Applications own endpoints, authentication, preview and messages. Do not pass adapter functions through data or WXML.

name: Video
title: Video 视频

description.en: Coordinate playback intent, visibility, progress and sound around native video.
description.zh: 围绕原生 video 协调播放意图、可见性、进度和声音。

when.en: Use when playback must cooperate with lifecycle and visibility.
when.zh: 播放需要配合页面生命周期和可见性时使用。

content.zh:
muted 默认 true，loop 默认 true。autoObserve 根据可见性阻塞播放，paused 是优先级更高的外部阻塞。play() 表达播放意图，不会绕过这些阻塞。

### 自定义播放按钮

替换基础 Video；controls="{{false}}" 关闭原生栏，自定义按钮仍走同一播放意图控制。

```xml
<rmp-video id="video" src="{{src}}" controls="{{false}}" show-custom-play-btn="{{true}}">
  <text slot="play">Play this video</text>
</rmp-video>
```
content.en:
muted and loop both default to true. autoObserve blocks playback based on visibility; paused is a higher-priority external blocker. play() expresses intent without bypassing blockers.

### Custom play control

Replace the basic Video. controls="{{false}}" hides the native bar; the custom button still follows the same playback intent.

```xml
<rmp-video id="video" src="{{src}}" controls="{{false}}" show-custom-play-btn="{{true}}">
  <text slot="play">Play this video</text>
</rmp-video>
```

faq.zh: 必须给外层容器确定高度，并提供可访问的视频资源。自动播放、全屏和声音受平台策略影响；playbacksummary.duration 是区间观看时长，mediaDuration 是素材时长。
faq.en: Give the outer container a definite height and supply an accessible video. Platform policies govern autoplay, fullscreen and sound. playbacksummary.duration is interval watch time; mediaDuration is the asset duration.

name: VideoGroup
title: VideoGroup 视频声音分组

description.en: Coordinate audible playback among descendant video participants without imposing a layout.
description.zh: 协调后代视频参与者的声音，不规定版式。

when.en: Use around related videos that should not play sound together.
when.zh: 用于不希望同时有声播放的一组视频。

content.zh:
用同一组包住多段 Video。当某一参与者打开声音时，其余成员被静音。也可显式调用 muteAll()，不影响组外的视频。

### 保留一个参与者的声音

给组内两个视频各加 id，在 Page 事件中执行。

```js
const current = this.selectComponent('#first-video');
this.selectComponent('#group').muteAll(current);
```
content.en:
Wrap related Videos in one group. When a participant activates sound, other members are muted. Call muteAll() explicitly without affecting videos outside the group.

### Keep one participant audible

Give the two child videos IDs and run this in a Page handler.

```js
const current = this.selectComponent('#first-video');
this.selectComponent('#group').muteAll(current);
```

faq.zh: 分组只协调声音，不自动组织布局，也不等于全局单例。自定义视频参与者可通过 useVideoParticipant 连接同一组。
faq.en: A group coordinates sound rather than layout and is not a global singleton. Custom video participants can join with useVideoParticipant.

methods: Mute other participants in this group.

name: Swiper
title: Swiper 轮播

description.en: Coordinate index, native transitions, stable item identity and optional carousel layouts.
description.zh: 协调索引、原生切换、稳定内容身份和可选轮播版式。

when.en: Use for images or custom generic item components.
when.zh: 用于图片或通过泛型内容组件展示的卡片。

content.zh:
layout="focus" 或 "coverflow" 提供相邻项展示；peek、gap 调整留白。默认泛型内容为 ImageItem，可用 generic:item 接入自己的内容组件。

### 相邻内容与指示器

替换基础示例的轮播，父容器继续保留确定高度。

```xml
<rmp-gallery id="gallery" items="{{items}}" item-key="id" layout="focus" peek="32px" gap="12px" indicator="{{true}}" />
```
content.en:
layout="focus" or "coverflow" displays neighboring items; peek and gap adjust spacing. ImageItem is the default generic renderer; generic:item can supply an application component.

### Neighboring content and indicators

Replace the basic carousel and retain a definite parent height.

```xml
<rmp-gallery id="gallery" items="{{items}}" item-key="id" layout="focus" peek="32px" gap="12px" indicator="{{true}}" />
```

faq.zh: 父容器必须确定高度。items 变更时通过 itemKey 保持身份；少于两项时不循环也不自动播放。to() 会归一化目标索引。
faq.en: The parent must define a height. itemKey preserves identity when items change. Fewer than two items disable looping and autoplay. to() normalizes the target index.

description.en: Render an image item for Swiper without controlling the carousel layout.
description.zh: 为 Swiper 渲染图片内容，不控制轮播版式。

when.en: Use as the default generic item renderer or on its own inside a sized container.
when.zh: 用于默认泛型内容渲染，也可在明确尺寸的容器内单独使用。

content.zh:
item.src 提供图片路径，item.mode 默认 aspectFill。Swiper 自动传入 item、index、active；应用只需要提供 items 数组。

### 改变图片填充方式

在 Page 方法中更新 item；item 与 active 由 Swiper 使用时自动传入。

```js
this.setData({ item: { src: '/assets/first.jpg', mode: 'aspectFit' } });
```
content.en:
item.src supplies the image path, and item.mode defaults to aspectFill. Swiper supplies item, index and active; applications usually only provide the items array.

### Change image fitting

Update item in a Page method. Swiper normally supplies item and active itself.

```js
this.setData({ item: { src: '/assets/first.jpg', mode: 'aspectFit' } });
```

faq.zh: ImageItem 不管理 current、循环或声音。自定义 item 必须接受同样的三项属性，尺寸由轮播容器和项目布局决定。
faq.en: ImageItem does not manage current index, looping or sound. A custom item must accept the same three properties; carousel and application layout determine dimensions.

active.en: Receives the active flag; the default image template does not vary its rendering with it.

description.zh: 适配图片和视频内容，并携带事件类型转发视频事件。

when.en: Use as the generic renderer for mixed media.
when.zh: 用于图片和视频混排的泛型内容渲染。

faq.en: MediaItem is a content adapter and does not advance the index. Standalone use must synchronize active so offscreen videos do not retain playback intent.
